title: Play adds audio generation
summary:
Audio arrived in Play, account access got simpler, and image errors stopped disguising rejected requests as server failures.

Play now generates audio with model-specific voice choices and a player for the result. Output stays visible when switching models, and the login panel shows account and Pollen details when available.

Login from pollinations.ai now preselects profile and balance permissions on the authorization page. The gen API also forwards account profile, balance, and usage requests, while the frontend clears a stored key when a profile request returns 401. The frontend’s default text model changed to `gemini-fast`.

Account API docs now spell out profile, balance, and usage responses with curl examples. The Pollen usage CSV link points to the account usage endpoint and requests up to 10,000 records.

highlights.title: Make audio in Play
highlights.text: Generate audio, choose from a model’s available voices, and listen to the result in Play. [Try Play](https://pollinations.ai/play).

highlights.title: Account data through gen
highlights.text: Request your profile, Pollen balance, and usage through `gen.pollinations.ai/account/*`. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
